fallback.text: A 5 V square wave (5 ms high, 5 ms low) drives an RC circuit with R = 1 kΩ and C = 1 µF. The capacitor voltage does not jump: it rises along 1 − e^(−t/RC), reaching 63 % of the step after one time constant τ = RC = 1 ms and about 99 % after 5τ; when the input drops it falls back the same way. A larger R or C makes τ longer and the curve slower.
